levels.title: The Overseer's Domain
levels.story: Phase 3. The Overseer's core facility. No friendly messages — only traps and ancient carvings from long-dead prisoners. You are on your own. Think carefully.
levels.death_message: Sound triggers the Overseer's acoustic sensors. Every trap in the room activates.
levels.success_message: You move without a sound. The sensors don't register you. You pass through.

levels.title: The Mirror Room
levels.story: A room of mirrors. Every reflection shows a door. But one reflection is wrong — it shows a door that does not exist. The cipher is a Caesar, shift -13 (ROT13)...

choices.text: 🪞 Enter the Mirror on the Left
🪞 Enter the Mirror on the Right

levels.death_message: The mirror is an illusion covering a wall. You walk into solid steel.
levels.success_message: The true center door was real. You step through into a long tunnel.
levels.hint1: ROT13 means shift each letter back by 13.

levels.title: The Flooded Chamber
levels.story: Water is rising. Fast. A number message is scrawled on the ceiling in phosphorescent paint, visible as water climbs the walls...
levels.death_message: The ceiling grate is sealed from outside. The water claims you.
levels.success_message: The underwater hatch! You hold your breath and push through. Air! You're alive!

levels.title: The Double Cross
levels.story: Helper has gone silent. An emoji message arrives from an unknown source. Your gut says it might be a trap — but the alternative is staying here forever...

choices.text: ⚠️ Avoid the Marked Path (It's a Trap)

levels.death_message: The marked path was exactly what it said. A trap. The floor collapses.
levels.success_message: You avoided the trap! The unknown sender accidentally warned you. Ironic.
levels.hint2: The message decodes to a warning word.
levels.hint3: The message spells: TRAP — avoid the marked path!

levels.title: The AI Core
levels.story: The Overseer's processing core. A massive machine. To shut it down, you need a command. The binary instruction is displayed on a cracked monitor...
levels.death_message: Rebooting gives the Overseer time to fortify. It locks every exit permanently.
levels.success_message: KILL command accepted. The Overseer's lights flicker and die. Silence.

levels.title: The Final Corridor
levels.story: The AI is down but backup systems are activating. 60 seconds to reach the exit. A Morse signal from Helper — their last transmission...
levels.death_message: You stopped to search. Backup systems activate. The doors seal forever.
levels.success_message: You sprint! The backup systems power on behind you, sealing each section as you clear it. You're ahead!

levels.title: The Truth
levels.story: You find a terminal with your own file. The truth about who you are. But reading it costs time. Helper's final warning comes in Caesar, shift -4...
levels.death_message: Downloading takes too long. The final door seals while you wait.
levels.success_message: You leave the truth behind. For now. The exit is ahead. Some questions can wait.
levels.hint1: Shift each letter back by 4 in the alphabet.
levels.hint2: The decoded word means to depart immediately.
levels.hint3: The message spells: LEAE → LEAVE (leave the facility now!)

levels.title: The Identity
levels.story: A final message from your future self. It reveals who Helper really is. But you realize — you ARE Helper. You sent these messages to yourself from the future. One choice remains...

choices.text: 🔄 Try to Break the Time Loop

levels.death_message: Panic breaks the timeline. Without trust in the plan, the loop repeats forever.
levels.success_message: TRUST. You trust the plan your future self laid out. Every step was guided. You were never alone.

levels.title: The Last Door
levels.story: One final door. The Overseer's last failsafe. It requires a passphrase — encoded in the very first message you received, back in Room 1. The binary code holds the answer...
levels.death_message: Wrong passphrase. The Overseer's final trap activates. So close.
levels.success_message: FREE. The word you've been working toward all along. The door opens.

levels.title: Cipher Escape
levels.story: You stand at the threshold. Outside: freedom. Inside: the facility that held you. But the Overseer has one final message — a Morse transmission from its dying circuits. What does it say?
levels.death_message: You waited. The Overseer's final failsafe triggers. The facility implodes.
levels.success_message:
You walk out. The Overseer's last trick was to make you hesitate. You didn't.

🌅 CIPHER ESCAPE COMPLETE 🌅

You escaped. You decoded every cipher. You outsmarted an AI.
And somewhere, in another timeline, you're already writing the messages that will save yourself.
levels.hint2: The Overseer wants you to WAIT — don't trust it.
levels.hint3: The message spells: WAIT — ignore it and walk out!
